evidence_span.text: Taken together, these findings demonstrate that NRP1 promotes endothelial tip cell function during angiogenesis.

reviews.rationale: Endothelial Nrp1 perturbation and mosaic analysis directly support its regulator role in tip-cell function and sprouting in the developing brain. Nrp1 is a regulator, so it does not enter supplied-gene coverage.

evidence_span.text: TGFβ treatment aggravated hypoxia-induced BBB permeability but ALK5 or Furin blockade reversed injury-induced permeability changes.

reviews.rationale: ALK5 blockade causally implicates Tgfbr1 signaling in brain endothelial BBB permeability. The hypoxic in vitro injury setting is transferable but not the target postnatal-development context, and Tgfbr1 is a regulator rather than a supplied gene.

evidence_span.text: Expression of EAAT-1 (Slc1a3), -2 (Slc1a2), and -3 (Slc1a1) mRNA in the endothelial cells was confirmed by conventional PCR and localization of EAAT-1 and -3 in endothelial cells was shown with immunofluorescence.

reviews.rationale: The paper provides Slc1a1-specific expression and localization plus family-level EAAT inhibition during polarized glutamate transport, supporting an associative but not Slc1a1-specific causal transport role. The bovine endothelial/rat astrocyte coculture is an indirect model of mouse postnatal brain endothelium.

evidence_span.text: Tgfβ-Smad2/3 signaling was attenuated, whereas phosphorylation of Smad1/5 and p38 were enhanced. Tgfβ pathway components, including Tgfβ2, Tgfβr2, Alk5, and integrins αVβ8, were reduced.

reviews.rationale: Foxf2 perturbation associates reduced pericyte Tgfbr2/Alk5 pathway components with BBB defects, giving pathway-level support but not receptor-specific perturbation or brain-endothelial action. The brain context is relevant, but the receptor measurements are in pericytes rather than the target endothelial cell type.
